events.description: Ross Geller says the General Tso's chicken is here.
Monica Geller asks who ordered the General Tso's chicken.
Chandler Bing says the person who ordered the General Tso's chicken was General Tso.
Rachel Green tells everyone to look.
Rachel Green says the old naked man is doing the hula hoop.
Monica Geller tells Ross Geller to look.
Monica Geller says Marcel took the remote control.
Ross Geller says that what happened is that Marcel does not like the television.
